what.text: This page follows refugees from Angola living in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 396 Angolan refugees in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 2.9% of all refugees from Angola.
France hosts the most Angolan refugees, followed by Canada, Germany and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Angola territory, then ruled by Portugal, from 1961 to 1974, and over the government of Angola from 1975 to 1995 and 1998 to 2002.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1967 to 1982, overlap both periods.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1960 at 150000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 626700, at the end of 1979, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
These are year-end totals for the Democratic Republic of the Congo only, reported to UNHCR.
